hook: A spot fire jumped the line. This Black Hawk went after it.
narration: This Black Hawk crew just let go of a bucket full of lake water over a burning Oregon forest.
It was the Hagen Fire in Umatilla County, on August tenth, twenty twenty six.
The helicopter was an HH-60M from the Oregon Army National Guard.
Riding along was a Cal Fire military helicopter manager, there to help find the next target.
To reload, they dipped the bucket straight into Langdon Lake.
A bucket on a long line lets the pilot stay above the trees and smoke, while the crew in the door watches the drop and talks him onto the spot.
[short pause] Then they found a new fire, burning outside the main fire's perimeter.
The Black Hawk came in right over the smoke.
outcome: The crew opened the bucket and poured Langdon Lake water straight onto the spot fire.
title: Black Hawk hits a spot fire in Oregon
description:
An Oregon Army National Guard HH-60M Black Hawk crew flies water bucket missions from Langdon Lake over the Hagen Fire in Umatilla County, Oregon, Aug. 10, 2026, and strikes a spot fire outside the main fire's perimeter.

Footage: Video by Maj. W. Chris Clyne, Oregon National Guard Public Affairs, via DVIDS: https://www.dvidshub.net/video/1018808/oregon-guard-hh-60-crew-drops-water-hagen-fire
